podcast.body: This album aimed to reflect music history with a song representing previous decades. However, "I Feel Love" stood out as a distinctly forward-looking track that surprised listeners. "I Feel Love is part of the album I remember yesterday, which is a look back at music history with a song that represents previous decades."

This album was based on a concept by Pete Bellotte, envisioning Side A with tracks recalling the 1940s, 50s, and 60s, and Side B featuring current-sounding tracks that concluded with a song representing the future. The album's futuristic closing track, "I Feel Love," was almost an afterthought but proved to be revolutionary. "a concept Balotti came up with called I Remember Yesterday. Side A would consist of tracks recalling the 1940s, 50s and 60s. Side B would feature current sounding tracks and close with a song that represented the future."
